title: Daily compare
summary: One day's sales next to the same weekday last week, the 4-week average and the same day last year.

blocks.text: Pick a day (yesterday by default). It is shown next to:

items: the average of that weekday over the 4 weeks before,
the same day last year, once there is a year of history.

blocks.text: Today can be picked too: it is compared with the same hours of the earlier days. ▲ is higher, ▼ lower, and a change under half a percent shows as =. The same line is added to the daily sales alert and the weekly digest.
